previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted with fever, hematuria, and flank pain, consistent with pyelonephritis in the setting of a chronic indwelling Foley catheter and recurrent UTIs. He was treated with IV ceftriaxone initially, then transitioned to oral cefpodoxime as his white blood cell count normalized and symptoms improved. Bladder spasms were managed with Detrol after intolerance to oxybutynin. Catheter leakage persisted despite size and taping adjustments, necessitating urology follow-up. Hyperkalemia was addressed by reducing losartan from 50mg to 25mg daily, with normalization of potassium levels. Normocytic anemia was noted but deemed stable for outpatient follow-up. Chronic pain and polysubstance use were managed with continued home medications as documented. He was discharged home in stable condition with plans for follow-up in urology and primary care.

ASSESSMENT & PLAN: ___ yo M with h/o T12 paraplegia and chronic 
indwelling foley with recurrent UTIs presents with 
fever,hematuria, flank pain, and leukocytosis and likely 
pyelonephritis.  

# Pyelonephritis: The patient presented with fevers, hematuria, 
leukocytosis, and left CVA tendernesss consistent with 
pyelonephritis. He was treated with IV ceftriaxone from HD ___. 
His urine Cx initally grew Klebsiella which was sensitive to 
Augmentin and  he subsequently transitoned to PO Augmentin on HD 
3. On HD 4 his urine Cx grew E. Coli as well, which  resistant 
to Augmentin and his white count trended up. Given the patient's 
allergies the patient was unable to be transitoned to another 
oral antibiotic to treat both bacteria. Given his history of 
substance abuse IV antibioics and PICC placement were not 
considered. He was ultimately placed on IM ertapenem and 
discharged with ___ to administerthis medication to complete a 
14 day antibiotic course on ___. He was afebrile for 48hs 
prior to discharge, however we were unable to asses his ___ 
trend since the patient refused labs on the day of discharge.

# Acute on Chronic kideny injury: The patient has a baseline Cr. 
of ___, and was admitted with Cr of 3.4. He received IVFs on HD 
1 and PO intake was encouraged. His Cr. improved to 2.6 the day 
prior to discharge.
